name: Relevance
description: The extent to which the response is relevant to the context and the interesting fact provided.

name: Engagement
description: The ability of the response to maintain or enhance the conversation's flow and engagement.

name: Clarity
description: The clarity and coherence of the response, including grammar and sentence structure.

name: Depth
description: The depth of information and insight provided in the response.

name: Creativity
description: The creativity and originality of the response, including the use of interesting facts or anecdotes.

name: Empathy
description: The extent to which the response demonstrates empathy and understanding of the other person's perspective.
